About University
About University
  • Uzbekistan is undergoing significant economic changes, creating excellent opportunities for new businesses.
  • As TEAM University—the first entrepreneurial university in Uzbekistan—we have partnered with the UK’s leading entrepreneurial institution, London South Bank University, to provide you with a world-class education. In order to produce business savvy graduates, we have the fine balance of experienced academic staff and leading successful entrepreneurs.
  • Our aim is to deliver practice-based, academically challenging and socially relevant education that provides a stimulating and fun student experience. Join us in building and realizing your vision of tomorrow!

OUR MISSION

Education that creates real impact

At TEAM University, our mission is to provide practice-based, academically challenging and socially relevant education that gives students a stimulating and meaningful university experience. We combine academic knowledge with real-world business experience to help students develop the skills, confidence and mindset needed to create value in the world around them.

OUR MISSION

Developing the entrepreneurs and
professionals of tomorrow

We strive to educate a generation of reflective, research-focused and entrepreneurial professionals who are prepared to make a
meaningful difference. Our vision is to create an environment where students are encouraged to think critically, explore new ideas and turn their ambitions into action.
